# Feature Request

Thank you for helping improve **Tech Monster**.

Use this template when you want to propose:

- A completely new feature
- A meaningful product improvement
- A new workflow
- A new user capability
- A significant change to an existing feature
- An improvement that requires coordinated frontend/backend changes

For small implementation details or obvious bug fixes, please use the
appropriate issue type instead.

Before creating this issue:

- Search existing issues and pull requests for similar proposals.
- Check whether the functionality already exists in another part of the
  application.
- Explain the user problem rather than describing only the implementation
  you have in mind.

## 7. Functional Requirements

<!--
List the behaviors that the feature must support.

Each requirement should describe observable behavior where possible.
-->

### Required

- [ ] The feature must be accessible from the appropriate application area.
- [ ] The feature must provide clear feedback when an action succeeds.
- [ ] The feature must provide clear feedback when an action fails.
- [ ] The feature must handle invalid or unexpected input safely.
- [ ] The feature must respect authentication and authorization rules where applicable.
- [ ] The feature must maintain existing application behavior outside its scope.

## 8. Non-Functional Requirements

Consider the following requirements where applicable.

### Performance

- [ ] The feature should not introduce unnecessary API requests.
- [ ] The feature should avoid unnecessary frontend re-renders.
- [ ] The feature should handle expected data volume efficiently.
- [ ] Performance requirements need further investigation.

### Security

- [ ] Authentication is required.
- [ ] Authorization / role checks are required.
- [ ] User input must be validated.
- [ ] Sensitive information must not be exposed.
- [ ] Rate limiting may be required.
- [ ] Security review is required.

### Accessibility

- [ ] Keyboard accessible
- [ ] Screen-reader friendly
- [ ] Proper semantic HTML
- [ ] Visible focus states
- [ ] Appropriate labels and accessible names
- [ ] Color should not be the only indicator of state

### Responsive Design

- [ ] Desktop
- [ ] Tablet
- [ ] Mobile
- [ ] Responsive behavior needs further design
